source: Owner direct chat after the controller summarized the remaining lobby work
owner_message_english_translation: I suggest we defer all of this for now and close the tasks. Then, after gameplay has been integrated here, I will write a list of what is needed.
decision: Close all currently open lobby tasks and defer their remaining work and owner-review gates. Future lobby work will be specified by the owner after gameplay integration.
status_meaning: Administrative closure of the current scope at the owner's request. This does not reject retained assets, grant new visual acceptance, or claim that deferred work and verification have been completed.

issues.scope: Remaining atmosphere and final walkthrough acceptance
Historical Variant A neutral 3D owner-review gate
Complete opaque materials and stone slab owner-review gate

deferred_scope: Entrance glazing refinement and unresolved visual R1
Further dressing, fixtures, signage, furniture and any owner-selected static damage
Final whole-scene route checks, comparable captures and performance acceptance
Remaining overall architecture/material/lobby owner acceptance and stable accepted asset registration/handoff
preserved: Current map, owner edits, all material bindings, native assets/sources, atmosphere, glass/support and gameplay
All existing evidence, failed trials, manifests and previously recorded scoped acceptances
Completed and previously cancelled Multica issues, including done MSQ-31 and MSQ-32

observed_saved_map.meaning: Read-only snapshot during administrative closure, not a new whole-lobby acceptance or a restriction on future owner/gameplay edits

supersedes: Earlier active/backlog/in-review lobby scheduling and the obligation to continue the remaining work or wait at the listed owner-review gates. Historical requirements remain reference material until replaced by a new owner scope.
resume_condition: A new owner-provided list after gameplay integration; no automatic resumption or dispatch from historical task documents.
